title: .vim 英語翻訳の vim plugin 化
label: enhancement
assignee: @.config/karabiner_elements
milestone:
---

## Description (説明)
現在、.vimrc に直接記述している英語翻訳の関数（機能）を vim plugin にして、.vimrc から取り除く

## Objectives / Points (目的・ポイント)
- vim plugin は git repository で管理(public)
- .vimrc を簡潔に保つ

## Expected Outcome (期待される結果)
- .vimrc から英語翻訳機能（関数）を全て取り除く
- 英語翻訳機能を vim plugin 化して再配布可能にする

## Notes (補足)
- 今後 issue 関連機能（関数）も vim plugin 化を検討

title: Create a vim plugin for the English translation function in .vim
label: enhancement
assignee: @.config/karabiner_elements
milestone:
---

## Description
Move the English translation function, which is currently written directly in .vimrc, into a vim plugin and remove it from .vimrc.

## Objectives / Points
- Manage the vim plugin in a public git repository.
- Keep .vimrc concise.

## Expected Outcome
- Remove all English translation functions from .vimrc.
- Make the English translation function redistributable by turning it into a vim plugin.

## Notes
- In the future, consider turning issue-related functions into a vim plugin as well.
